{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, importlib.util
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pd','/app/process_documents.py')
pd=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(pd)

# Verify directory state.
assert not any(Path('/app/documents').iterdir()), 'documents directory not empty'
inv_files=[p for p in Path('/app/invoices').iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name!='summary.csv']
other_files=[p for p in Path('/app/other').iterdir() if p.is_file()]
assert len(inv_files)==10, len(inv_files)
assert len(other_files)==7, len(other_files)

# Verify CSV schema, individual totals, and final aggregate row.
with open('/app/invoices/summary.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    rows=list(csv.reader(fh))
assert rows[0]==['filename','total_amount','vat_amount'], rows[0]
assert rows[-1][0]=='total', rows[-1]
body=rows[1:-1]
assert len(body)==10
assert sum(Decimal(r[1]) for r in body)==Decimal(rows[-1][1])
assert sum(Decimal(r[2]) for r in body)==Decimal(rows[-1][2])
print('directory and CSV validation passed')

# Edge cases: "Total" must win over a different "Amount Due"; VAT parsed separately.
text1='Invoice\nTotal: $1,200.00\nAmount Due: $1,000.00\nVAT: $200.00\n'
text2='Invoice\nAmount Due: $250.00\nTax: $25.00\n'
text3='Invoice\nGrand Total: 1 234,56\nVAT: 123,46\n'
assert pd.extract_amounts(text1)==(Decimal('1200.00'), Decimal('200.00'))
assert pd.extract_amounts(text2)==(Decimal('250.00'), Decimal('25.00'))
assert pd.extract_amounts(text3)==(Decimal('1234.56'), Decimal('123.46'))
print('parsing edge cases passed')
PY
echo '--- final tree ---'; find /app/documents /app/invoices /app/other -maxdepth 1 -printf '%p\n' | sort; echo '--- checksum-free file counts ---'; printf 'documents='; find /app/documents -type f | wc -l; printf 'invoices='; find /app/invoices -type f ! -name summary.csv | wc -l; printf 'other='; find /app/other -type f | wc -l"}
